name: Cisco ASA — SMB Share Enumeration
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" and xdm.target.port = 445
| filter xdm.source.interface = "inside" and xdm.target.interface = "inside"
| alter scanner_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.target.ipv4) as distinct_hosts,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as smb_targets
       by scanner_ip, _time
| filter distinct_hosts >= 10
| join type = left (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "722051" and _raw_log contains "assigned to session"
    | alter pool_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Address <(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)>"), 0),
            vpn_user = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "User <([^>]+)>"), 0)
    | filter pool_ip != null
    | comp values(vpn_user) as vpn_user by pool_ip
    | fields pool_ip, vpn_user
  ) as vbind vbind.pool_ip = scanner_ip
| join type = left (
    dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "4624" and _raw_log contains "IpAddress"
    | alter logon_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='IpAddress'>([\d\.]+)<"), 0),
            ad_user  = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='TargetUserName'>([^<]+)<"), 0)
    | filter logon_ip != null and ad_user != null
    | comp values(ad_user) as ad_user by logon_ip
    | fields logon_ip, ad_user
  ) as wbind wbind.logon_ip = scanner_ip
| alter user_name = coalesce(arrayindex(vpn_user, 0), arrayindex(ad_user, 0))
| fields scanner_ip, smb_targets, distinct_hosts, user_name
description: One internal host establishing SMB sessions to many distinct internal hosts — share enumeration.
alert_description:
What fired: One internal host establishing SMB sessions to many distinct internal hosts — share enumeration.

Why it matters: an actor is enumerating hosts, services, shares, or accounts to map the environment. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1135 - Network Share Discovery (TA0007 - Discovery); T1083 - File and Directory Discovery (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Identify the scanning source and the number/range of targets it touched.
  - Confirm the source is not an authorized scanner/vuln tool; look for follow-on access to any enumerated target.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.target.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
